description_excerpt: FOOTWEAR (FW) MATERIALS DEVELOPER II VIETNAM HO CHI MINH CITY, VIETNAM WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH In this role, you’ll partner with cross-functional teams across the Partner Management Office (PMO), Phil Knight Campus (PHK), and Product Creation Center (PCC) to surface issues early and collaborate on effective solutions. You’ll serve as the primary vendor contact for material-specific matters, including pricing, technical specifications, and performance. Based at the Nike Vietnam Office in Ho Chi Minh City, this role reports to the Director, FW Material Development Lead Vietnam. WHO WE ARE LOOKING…
